trends.headline: Pacific Wheel is packed after 6
trends.snippet: Ferris wheel line wrapping the arcade. Sunset slot is a 40-minute wait and nobody is leaving.

trends.headline: Third Street buskers vs. the speakers
trends.snippet: A saxophone, a Bluetooth speaker, and a mime. Saturday night as designed.

trends.headline: Bike path southbound is a parade
trends.snippet: Ocean Park to Venice is bumper-to-bumper on two wheels. Walk the sand instead.

trends.headline: Montana Ave brunch overflow
trends.snippet: Sidewalk tables full by 10. If you wanted a quiet coffee, you picked the wrong avenue.

trends.headline: Palisades Park is doing the postcard
trends.snippet: Sky going peach over the pier. Bring a jacket. Marine layer already rolling in.

trends.headline: E Line into Downtown SM
trends.snippet: Metro E Line terminus at 4th and Colorado. Big Blue Bus on Ocean and Olympic.
